email.subject: Bright Pros Dentistry: two quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I checked Bright Pros Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you new patients: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching "dentist Harbor Falls" can't call you without hunting for a number, and there's no online booking, so anyone browsing after hours just leaves instead of grabbing a slot. The site also isn't mobile-friendly and loads slowly from large images, and there are no patient reviews shown.

I fix these for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's losing you patients, no pressure either way.

Would Tuesday or Wednesday work?

Alex
Northlight Web
